name: Peça N (reconstrução)
assumptions: Origin: X=0 on the bore/tunnel axis, Y=0 front face, Z=0 underside; bore axis at Y=35 (from 50/70/10 dims and view alignment).

Inclined arm modelled as a constant vertical thickness 10 (perpendicular thickness 10*cos30=8.66) with a vertical root face on the line (-30,45)-(-40,25) and an end face perpendicular to the arm; read from view B geometry, not dimensioned.
Arm width 22.36 (=10*sqrt5) derived from the root edge in the top view (dims 10 and 20); arm direction in plan perpendicular to arrow B (tan = 1/2).
Length 40 in view C taken on the upper face from the root (bend) edge; R10 notch centred on the back lateral edge, 20 from the end, axis perpendicular to the arm face.
Base lug outline = convex hull of R10 circle and corner (-30,50) [left] / (30,20) [right]; base thickness 10; R30 half-shell concentric with R25 tunnel (gives the visible steps at X=+-28.28).
Ribs 5 thick centred on Y=35, from boss to X=+-40, top line from (20,45) to (40,10) per section A-A dims (15 and 80).
Groove on the right boss rim: width 20 (Y 25..45, aligned with arm band), depth 5; counterbore Ø30 depth 10 (Z 50..60) from the left '10' dimension line.
